summary: Iteration 19 - SaaS Billing System Testing Complete. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend UI components for SaaS plans management, assignment, and subscription are fully functional.
passed_tests: GET /api/saas/plans returns list of SaaS plans with 12 feature flags
POST /api/saas/plans creates a new SaaS plan with all feature flags
PUT /api/gyms/{id}/saas-plan assigns SaaS plan to gym (Super Admin only)
GET /api/saas/my-subscription returns gym's current subscription (Gym Admin)
POST /api/saas/subscribe returns proper error when PLATFORM_STRIPE_KEY not set
AdminPlans page (/admin/plans) shows plans grouped by gym for Super Admin
AdminSaaSPlans page (/admin/saas-plans) shows SaaS plans with feature badges and pricing
AdminSaaSPlans - Create new SaaS plan form works with 12 feature toggles
AdminSaaSPlans - Assign plan to gym modal works
Gym Admin Settings shows 'Mi Plan SaaS' section with plan name, price, capacity bar
Mi Plan SaaS section shows features grid with check/X icons
Cambiar Plan button shows available plans for subscription
Stripe subscription error handled correctly (shows 'Stripe de la plataforma no configurado')
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: saas_routes.py properly implements all 12 feature flags in SAAS_FEATURE_KEYS
Backend: Role-based access control working - Super Admin only for CRUD operations
Backend: Stripe subscription endpoint correctly checks for PLATFORM_STRIPE_KEY
Frontend: AdminSaaSPlans.js has proper data-testid attributes for testing
Frontend: AdminSettings.js MiPlanSection component displays all subscription info correctly
Frontend: Feature toggles in create form properly bound to state
Frontend: Capacity bar shows correct percentage with color coding (green/yellow/red)

success_rate.backend: 94% (16/17 tests passed, 1 skipped - no free plan available)

test_credentials.gym_admin: admin@fitzone.com / admin123 (FitZone Gym with Plan Inicial)

seed_data_creation: None - used existing SaaS plans (Plan Inicial, Plan Profesional, Plan Premium)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 19 tested the SaaS billing system. Three SaaS plans exist: Plan Inicial (€29.99, 100 members, 2 features), Plan Profesional (€59.99, 500 members, 7 features), Plan Premium (€99.99, 2000 members, 12 features). FitZone Gym has Plan Inicial assigned. PLATFORM_STRIPE_KEY is NOT set, so Stripe checkout will fail with expected error. The 'badge-feature' CSS class is used for feature tags in AdminSaaSPlans.

features: Plan cards with pricing and feature count
Shows which gyms have each plan
Plans grouped by gym for Super Admin
Gym select in create modal for Super Admin
Available plans selector with subscribe buttons
